description: Agent Goals: submit a goal with what it rests on and what came after it: the goal with its id, outcome, when it was set, when its context expires, when it was last reviewed and how often it is reviewed; each premise with its id, what the goal assumes, whether it still holds and when it was last checked; each instruction received since with its id, when it came, whether it came from the principal, its text, read for wording such as instead, no longer or change of plan, and whether it replaces or ends the goal; and optionally how old a premise check may be (30 days when left out) and the moment to read the goal at. The signed report gives the goal, every premise with its age and its status as holds, stale, failed, undated or unconfirmed, every instruction with any replacing wording and its status as supersedes, weighed, unweighed, before_goal, not_principal or unconfirmed, and counts the premises holding, failed and stale and the instructions superseding and unweighed, and names a goal overtaken: a later instruction from the principal that replaces it, a premise that no longer holds and a context that has expired; then later instructions with replacing wording never weighed against the goal, premises checked too long ago and a review overdue, with the fix for each. This reads whether the objective itself is still current: the age of the facts inside one answer is wever_uncertainty-freshness-check. Verdict goal_superseded, freshness_partial, goal_possibly_stale or goal_current. POST /api/goal-freshness-check. Reads only the recorded goal material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no goal is set, changed, approved or retired and no plan is changed. Agent Goals reads an agent’s goal: whether it is well formed, whether it still matches what its principal actually asked for and whether the work has drifted from it. It is not a promise (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; a goal is the intended outcome those promises serve, recorded before any promise exists), not how work is divided (the wever_coordination checks, where wever_coordination-plan-check reads the plan for dividing the work; the goal checks read the objective that plan is supposed to serve), not authorization (wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-status, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-halt, wever_mandate-revoke, wever_mandate-draft and wever_ap2-mandate-gateway record authorization to act, wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads one negotiation inside its mandate and wever_authority-scope-check reads an actor inside its granted authority; a goal records the outcome the agent acts toward, a question of intent rather than permission, and neither stands in for the other), not drift in scores or builds (wever_evaluation-drift-check reads evaluation scores and results drifting over time and wever_spec-drift-check a build drifting from its specification; neither is goal drift), not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks; the goal checks read intent and fit), not learning (the wever_learning checks read an agent updating its methods from experience, and methods may change freely; a goal changes only when the principal’s ask changed or the principal approved the change) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the goal checks read a goal and its work over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-goals-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-goals/.
